source: Physical meter photos and local Itron Gen5 PDFs added 2026-06-07
notes: Photo OCR/vision is subject to glare/reflection; LCD/register values are the least reliable observations.
Both physical meters appear to be Itron Gen5 Riva single-phase electric smart meters with integrated service switches.

The Opower metadata currently exposes two service point utility IDs but not the physical meter serial numbers, so serial-to-account mapping remains unconfirmed unless Eversource metadata or field labeling later links them.

lcd_observations: IMG_1688/1689 do not provide a reliable kWh register due to glare/cropping.
IMG_1687 appears to show display code 82 and numeric value about 10098, likely an energy register, but confidence is only medium due to glare/cropping.
IMG_1686 appears to show display code 82 and unit kVARh with a mostly-zero/uncertain value; do not treat it as a billing kWh reading.
